name: Swift Checkout for WooCommerce
author: bdthemes

sections.description:
🛒 Transform Your WooCommerce Checkout Experience with Swift Checkout!

Swift Checkout is the ultimate WooCommerce checkout optimization plugin that dramatically reduces cart abandonment and skyrockets your conversion rates. Built with modern web standards and user experience in mind, this powerful plugin creates a seamless, lightning-fast checkout process that your customers will love.

✨ Why Choose Swift Checkout?

In today’s competitive eCommerce landscape, a slow or complicated checkout process can cost you sales. Swift Checkout eliminates friction by providing a streamlined, one-page checkout solution that gets your customers from cart to completed purchase in record time.

🎯 Key Features That Drive Results:

  • ⚡ Lightning-Fast AJAX Processing – No page reloads, instant updates
  • 📱 Mobile-First Responsive Design – Perfect on all devices
  • 🎨 Dual Page Builder Support – Works with both Elementor and Gutenberg
  • 🔧 Customizable Checkout Fields – Tailor forms to your business needs
  • 🛍️ Smart Auto Add-to-Cart – Streamline product selection
  • 💳 Universal Payment Gateway Support – Compatible with all WooCommerce payment methods
  • 🎛️ Variable Product Support – Handle complex product variations effortlessly
  • 📊 Real-Time Cart Updates – Dynamic quantity changes and price calculations
  • 🌐 Translation Ready – Fully internationalized for global stores
  • 🚀 Performance Optimized – Minimal impact on site speed

🏆 Perfect For:

  • eCommerce Store Owners looking to reduce cart abandonment
  • Digital Agencies building client websites
  • WordPress Developers seeking robust checkout solutions
  • Marketing Teams focused on conversion optimization
  • Business Owners wanting to maximize online sales

🔥 Advanced Functionality:

Smart Field Management: Configure required and optional fields with drag-and-drop simplicity. From basic contact information to detailed shipping addresses, control exactly what information you collect.

Seamless Integration: Works flawlessly with your existing WooCommerce setup, payment gateways, shipping methods, and tax calculations. No conflicts, no complications.

Developer-Friendly: Clean, extensible code with proper WordPress hooks and filters. Easy to customize and extend for specific business requirements.

Performance Focused: Optimized database queries, efficient AJAX handling, and minimal resource usage ensure your site stays fast even during high-traffic periods.

🎨 Visual Page Builder Integration:

  • Elementor Widget – Drag-and-drop checkout forms with live preview
  • Gutenberg Block – Native WordPress editor integration
  • Shortcode Support – Use anywhere with simple shortcodes
  • Template Override – Full control over checkout appearance

🔒 Security & Reliability:

Built following WordPress and WooCommerce security best practices with proper data sanitization, nonce verification, and secure AJAX handling. Your customers’ data is always protected.

🎯 Boost Your Conversions Today!

Don’t let a complicated checkout process cost you sales. Swift Checkout transforms your WooCommerce store into a conversion machine with its intuitive, fast, and flexible checkout solution.

💎 Premium Features Include:
* One-click product selection
* Dynamic shipping method updates
* Real-time order total calculations
* Customizable field validation
* Mobile-optimized interface
* Cross-browser compatibility

Transform your checkout experience and watch your conversion rates soar with Swift Checkout!

Additional Info

🏆 About bdthemes:
Swift Checkout is developed by bdthemes, a leading WordPress development team known for creating high-quality, performance-focused plugins and themes.

💬 Support & Documentation:

* Support Forum
* Video Tutorials
* Feature Requests

🌟 Love Swift Checkout?
If Swift Checkout has helped boost your conversions, please consider leaving a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review. Your feedback helps us continue improving the plugin!
sections.installation:
📥 Automatic Installation (Recommended):

  1. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard
  2. Navigate to Plugins → Add New
  3. Search for “Swift Checkout”
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate
  5. Configure settings under Swift Checkout menu

📁 Manual Installation:

  1. Download the plugin zip file
  2. Upload to /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  3. Extract the files
  4. Activate through Plugins menu
  5. Configure your checkout settings

⚙️ Setup Requirements:
* WordPress 6.8 or higher
* WooCommerce plugin (latest version recommended)
* PHP 7.2 or higher
* Modern web browser
sections.faq:
🤔 What makes Swift Checkout different from other checkout plugins?

Swift Checkout stands out with its dual page builder support (Elementor + Gutenberg), lightning-fast AJAX processing, and mobile-first design. Unlike other plugins that focus on just one aspect, Swift Checkout provides a complete checkout transformation with customizable fields, real-time updates, and seamless WooCommerce integration.

🛒 Does Swift Checkout work with all WooCommerce themes?

Absolutely! Swift Checkout is designed to work with any WordPress theme that supports WooCommerce. It uses its own styling system that adapts to your theme’s design while maintaining optimal functionality. The plugin has been tested with popular themes like Astra, GeneratePress, OceanWP, and many more.

💳 Which payment gateways are supported?

Swift Checkout supports all WooCommerce payment gateways including PayPal, Stripe, Square, WooCommerce Payments, and hundreds of others. Since it integrates seamlessly with WooCommerce’s payment system, any gateway that works with WooCommerce will work with Swift Checkout.

📱 Is the checkout process mobile-friendly?

Yes! Swift Checkout is built with a mobile-first approach. The checkout forms are fully responsive and optimized for touch interactions. The interface adapts perfectly to smartphones, tablets, and desktop computers, ensuring a smooth experience across all devices.

🎨 Can I customize the checkout fields and layout?

Definitely! Swift Checkout offers extensive customization options. You can:
– Add, remove, or reorder checkout fields
– Set fields as required or optional
– Customize field labels and placeholders
– Choose from multiple layout presets
– Style the checkout form to match your brand
– Use Elementor or Gutenberg for visual editing

🔧 Do I need coding knowledge to use Swift Checkout?

Not at all! Swift Checkout is designed for users of all technical levels. The plugin includes:
– Easy-to-use admin interface
– Visual page builder widgets
– Drag-and-drop field management
– Pre-built templates and presets
– Comprehensive documentation
However, developers will appreciate the clean, extensible code structure.

🚀 Will Swift Checkout slow down my website?

No! Swift Checkout is performance-optimized and actually improves site speed by:
– Using efficient AJAX calls instead of page reloads
– Implementing smart caching strategies
– Minimizing database queries
– Loading assets only when needed
– Following WordPress performance best practices

🌐 Is Swift Checkout translation-ready for international stores?

Yes! Swift Checkout is fully internationalized and translation-ready. It includes:
– Complete .pot file for translations
– RTL (Right-to-Left) language support
– WPML and Polylang compatibility
– Multi-currency support through WooCommerce
– Date and number format localization

🛍️ Does it support variable products and complex product types?

Absolutely! Swift Checkout handles all WooCommerce product types:
– Simple products
– Variable products with multiple attributes
– Grouped products
– External/affiliate products
– Subscription products (with compatible plugins)
– Booking products (with compatible plugins)
The plugin automatically displays appropriate variation selectors and updates pricing in real-time.

🔒 How secure is Swift Checkout?

Extremely secure! Swift Checkout follows WordPress and WooCommerce security best practices:
– Proper nonce verification for all AJAX requests
– Complete data sanitization and validation
– Secure handling of customer information
– No sensitive data stored unnecessarily
– Regular security audits and updates
– Compliance with GDPR and privacy regulations
